narrative.overview: The page reads like a friendly field guide to space stories. Broad, flat land shapes set the scene; familiar headings and a normal reading order keep the project easy to understand. Warm paper-colored water, expressive Gabarito typography, and small capsule markers add a playful sense of exploration without relying on paid services or external imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Flat green land against warm cream water.
Rounded, high-contrast markers for routes, destinations, and project status.
Oversized, closely tracked headlines paired with readable body copy.
Map motion decorates the page; standard links remain the navigation.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Keep surfaces unraised; use color and spacing to establish hierarchy.

dos: Use the established palette and Gabarito Variable.
Keep the map decorative and preserve normal document reading order.
Only publish gameplay rules the team has confirmed.
donts: Don't add gradients, grain, or map-shaped navigation.
Don't invent player counts, turns, setup, or win conditions.
Don't make paid APIs or services required.
